name: Creamy Tuna Pasta with Peas
description: A fast, one-skillet creamy tuna pasta that leans on pantry staples — canned tuna, pasta, and a jar of Alfredo sauce. Mild and kid-friendly.
recipeIngredient: 12 ounces canned tuna, or 2 cans, or 5 ounce drained
recipeInstructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta until tender, then drain and set aside.
While the pasta cooks, melt the butter with the minced garlic in a large skillet over medium heat; sauté about 1 minute until fragrant (do not brown).
Add the frozen peas with a pinch of salt and pepper; cook 2-3 minutes until heated through.
Stir in the Alfredo sauce and bring to a gentle simmer, stirring, 2-3 minutes until warmed through.
Add the drained pasta and stir to coat. Sprinkle in the Parmesan and stir until melted; turn off the heat.
Gently fold in the drained tuna, keeping some chunks. Taste and adjust salt and pepper. Serve warm.
